text:
Maya Patel: Hi team, Maya here starting in Platform next week. I can view the "Platform Onboarding" Notion space but can't edit templates. My manager asked me to curate the first-week checklist and hand it off to the buddy. Who owns the canonical template and what's the cleanest way to request temporary team editors so the buddy + manager can collaborate?

Chris Hall: Welcome Maya! Canonical onboarding templates are usually owned by the team listed in the page properties (check right-hand panel). For a handoff workflow: (A) duplicate the canonical into Team > Platform > Onboard-Drafts, (B) mark the duplicate with `Status=Draft` and `Source=canonical-URL`, (C) request page-level editors for the manager + buddy rather than workspace editors.

devex: Quick request format that we can action fast. Paste this in a DM to @devex or post here:

```
@devex please add Editor on <NOTION_URL> for:
- Maya Patel (maya@redwood.com)
- Liam Ortiz (liam@redwood.com)
- Chris Hall (chris@redwood.com)
Duration: 21 days
Reason: curate first-week checklist and handoff to buddy
```

docs-bot: Two important automation caveats: (1) automations (Slack/Jira/Zapier) bind to page IDs, not titles, so a duplicate will not inherit webhooks. (2) our archival scripts ignore pages with `Status=Draft` or names prefixed with `DRAFT -`. If you plan to promote a draft to canonical, ping ops to re-register webhooks.

Maya Patel: Good to know about webhooks. Is there a recommended property we should add so reviewers can see the approval stage and to avoid accidental promotion?

Chris Hall: We use three properties on drafts: `Status` (Draft/Review/Canonical), `Reviewers` (People), and `ApprovalDate` (Date). Set `Status=Review` when you want a manager sign-off. Only once `Status=Canonical` does the ops team reattach automations.

Liam Ortiz: One extra step for handoffs I like: add a tiny check at top of the draft with a single-line template showing current owner and next owner, e.g., "Owner: Maya P. -> Handoff to: Liam O. (on 2026-07-01)". It makes it clear who edits the canonical after promotion.

devex: Also if you want to make some fields mandatory before promotion, add a page-level property `ReadyForPublish` (Select: No/Yes) and require `ReadyForPublish=Yes` before asking ops to promote. Docs triage watches for that tag.

Maya Patel: Great. A couple practical asks: (1) I need to remove a couple of internal-only links from the checklist before sharing with new hires. Is that OK in a draft? (2) If I duplicate a template that contains a database of tasks, will the task rows keep the same schema and comments?

docs-bot: (1) Yes, sanitize internal links in the draft. If anything references PII or closed tickets, replace with placeholders. (2) Database schema and comments are copied on duplicate. Row-level automations (like auto-assign via Zapier) will not trigger until the row is created in a page that the automation monitors. Also note: comments on the canonical do not copy over to the duplicated page.

People Ops (Rae): If any checklist items reference HR forms or onboarding paperwork, tag me and I'll sanity-check the public-friendly wording. We prefer placeholders instead of links to restricted HR pages in new-hire facing copies.

Maya Patel: Thanks Rae. One more workflow Q: after handoff, how should we formally transfer ownership in Notion so the Owner property matches our org directory and my manager can find it later?

Chris Hall: After manager approval: 1) Change `Status=Canonical`, 2) Update `Owner` property to the new person's Notion account, 3) Move page into Team > Platform > Templates or the canonical folder, 4) Add a page comment like "Promoted to canonical by <manager> on <date>". Then ping @devex to reattach any automations if needed.

devex: We'll also run a small safety check when you request promotion. Include the canonical target folder in the DM and we'll confirm automation handoffs. Example promote request:

```
@devex please promote https://redwood.notion.so/Platform-Onboard-draft123 to canonical
Target folder: Redwood > Eng > Platform > Templates
Promoted by: Chris Hall (chris@redwood.com)
Reason: Completed review and sanitized links
```

Liam Ortiz: FYI we have a tiny script that indexes canonical templates for the docs site; it looks for `Status=Canonical` and an `Owner` property. So make sure Owner is set to a person, not a text field.

Maya Patel: Perfect. I'll duplicate into Team > Platform > Onboard-Drafts, set Status=Draft and add Reviewers: Chris + Liam, sanitize links, and DM @devex with the editor request block. Thanks everyone for the help! :wave: :tada:
